paragraphs.text: Zuberi is a legendary griffin of Jamuraa .
Zuberi is a majestic griffin. His plumage is a brilliant, dazzling gold, his large eyes gleam red, and his claws are long and sharp.

While Zuberi was alive in Jamuraa during the Mirage War hundreds of years ago, it is unknown if he, like most Jamuraan griffins, was present in Zhalfir when Teferi Akosa phased it out. If he was, he might still be alive on the extant plane. His descendant, Zeriam , is one of the few remaining griffins on Jamuraa.
Zuberi is derived from the Arabic name Zubayr , meaning "strong" or "brave".
